picks.excerpt: At the IPA Congress closing gala, two AI companies won the IPA Innovation in Publishing Award: Shimmr, which built an autonomous subscription-based 'Advertising as a Service' AI platform for continuous book marketing, and Ailaysa, a multilingual AI company behind the Chai Reader discovery platform.
picks.rationale: Concrete new substance from the IPA Congress close: publishing's own innovation award went to two named AI companies (Shimmr for autonomous book marketing, Ailaysa for multilingual publishing) — a real signal of which AI tools the industry is endorsing. Kept over the PW closing wrap, which covers the same day with less specific detail.

picks.excerpt: Amazon's Kindle Recaps — AI-generated, spoiler-free 'previously on...' summaries of series and in-progress books — is now accessible via an internet browser, expanding the feature beyond Kindle devices and apps.
picks.rationale: Actionable product move: Amazon's genAI Kindle Recaps feature broadens reach to any browser, changing how readers (and authors thinking about series discoverability) engage with in-progress books. Fresh 07-05 and not previously covered.

picks.excerpt: 중국 무료 웹소설 플랫폼들이 AI 생성 소설을 AI로 판별해 대규모 단속(한 달 10만권 이상 계약 거부)에 나서면서, 인간 작가들이 되레 'AI처럼 보이지 않는 글쓰기'를 고민해야 하는 역설이 벌어지고 있다.
picks.rationale: Distinct, high-novelty story: Chinese webnovel platforms are using AI to detect and mass-reject AI-written fiction (100k+ contracts refused/month), pushing human authors to actively write so their prose 'doesn't look like AI' — a concrete craft consequence with no on-list coverage elsewhere.

dropped_as_published_duplicate.reason: Follow-up of the Granta/Commonwealth AI-accusation card published 2026-06-29; judged a content duplicate in both prior runs. Adds nothing substantially new. Dropped per hard exclusion.

dropped_within_pool.reason: Same event (IPA Congress closing day, 07-08) as the kept Publishing Perspectives Innovation Award piece. Selected at most one closing-day item; kept the one with the most concrete new substance (names specific AI winners Shimmr and Ailaysa).
